purpose: Select and freeze the sole artifact identity, URL, byte ceiling, integrity checks, and post-acquisition stop rule for a future separately authorized first bounded acquisition of REPROD. This contract selects dots.zip only for an initial derived-provenance manifest and rights screen. It does not authorize download, archive inspection, source-role admission, catalog mutation, quota, sample construction, baseline, or fine-tuning.

selection_reasons: dots.zip is one immutable Zenodo object with an exact byte size and MD5, so a first acquisition can be bounded to one object and 10928971753 bytes.
Its central directory can later test whether derived graph outputs expose stable label-independent execution grouping and notice surfaces before incurring the raw multipart cost.
The raw PML is a 13-object split ZIP totaling 133778960405 bytes. Reliable member access and content integrity require treating the multipart set as one acquisition unit.

Zenodo metadata does not publish an independently downloadable or independently checksummed PML member subset, so a metadata-only reviewer cannot define a scientifically reproducible bounded PML subset.
Selecting DOT minimizes acquisition cost while preserving fail-closed review; it does not claim that derived graphs are interchangeable with raw endpoint evidence.
surface_selection.scientific_scope_limit: A successful DOT audit may support only a later review of REPROD as a derived provenance-evidence surface. It cannot approve raw ProcMon PML evidence, prove the 405 raw executions, or establish that the LLM compiled raw evidence into the DOT graphs.

alternatives_not_selected.reason: Scientifically preferred for raw endpoint evidence but disproportionate for the first fail-closed manifest and rights screen. A future raw-PML contract must freeze all 13 volumes as one integrity unit and obtain separate capacity and execution authorization.

No official object-level subset, member manifest with independent checksums, or server-side member retrieval identity is published. Selecting byte ranges or guessed members would not create an independently verifiable source artifact.
Summary or label-bearing metadata is outside the model, pointer, grouping, and supervision surfaces pending a separate field-level review.

future_execution_controls.terminal_failure_action: Record a sanitized target, observed bytes, process exit status, and stderr; stop without retry, resume, source substitution, archive opening, PML fallback, role change, or quota change.

verification_order: Confirm that the downloaded object is at the frozen local relative path.
Confirm that exact byte size equals expected_bytes and does not merely fall below the ceiling.
Compute MD5 only after exact size passes.
Compare lowercase hexadecimal MD5 byte-for-byte with expected_md5.
Record verified only if both exact size and MD5 pass.

forbidden_actions: Download dots.zip under this contract-drafting authorization.
Download any PML multipart object, summary.csv, another record revision, concept record, mirror, cache, byte-range subset, or renamed object.
Treat a byte range, local slice, or guessed archive member as an independently checksummed PML subset.
Open, list, extract, or read the selected archive before a reader-pinned audit contract and separate execution authority exist.
Treat archive verification, DOT member count, output count, filename count, or SHA count as source-role or lineage approval.
Read summary.csv, labels, detector outputs, malware-family fields, hidden answers, or ground truth.
Generate training samples, run a model, alter Kernel or Gamma, connect M3, write the effective catalog, change quota, or mark L2 passed.

authority.next_action: If separately authorized, acquire only reprod_dots_derived_provenance_archive once and stop after exact-size plus MD5 verification. Only after verification may a separate reader-pinned central-directory and nested-notice contract be executed.
